title: fix: let publishable keys edit redirect URIs and earnings settings
author: davealan74
pr_body_excerpt:
- `EditApiKeyDialog` gated both the redirect-URI/earnings section and the metadata POST on `isAppKey`, which requires a key to *already* have a redirect URI or earnings enabled. A plain publishable key could therefore never get its first one: the section was hidden, and edits were silently dropped on save.
- Both gates now use `isPublishableKey`, so the save gate can no longer be narrower than what the user is shown.
- Moved the metadata POST ahead of `onUpdate()`. `onUpdate` ends in `router.invalidate()`, so the list refetched before the metadata write landed and the dialog closed onto a stale card.
- Moved the shared key predicates into `key-type.ts`; their logic is unchanged.

Notes:

- Visible UX change: every publishable key now shows the redirect-URI/earnings section, and saving a first redirect URI moves the card from the "API keys" group to "App keys".
- The POST-before-`onUpdate` ordering has no automated guard — `enter.pollinations.ai` runs the Workers vitest pool with no DOM environment, so `handleSave` can't be rendered. It carries an inline comment; the gating logic it depends on is unit-tested.

Test: `cd enter.pollinations.ai && npx vitest run test/edit-api-key-dialog.test.ts` — 6 passed.

Fixes #10983

gist.headline: App keys can sprout
gist.blurb: Plain publishable keys can finally grow their first redirect URI or earnings setting. The garden gate was checking whether the flower had already bloomed.
gist.summary: Fixed the API-key edit dialog so every publishable key can set its first redirect URI or earnings option, with metadata saved before the key list refreshes.
gist.impact: Users can now turn a publishable key into an app key by saving its first redirect URI, and the updated card immediately moves from “API keys” to “App keys.”
gist.visual_concept: Depict a previously plain key growing into an app-key flower after Polli adds its first redirect-URI tag. A cozy key garden visually shows the key moving from an “API KEYS” planter to an “APP KEYS” planter, while a small retro terminal confirms the save landed before the garden refreshes.
